mapper.select: SELECT user.user_id AS teacherId, user.user_name AS teacherUserName, user.nick_name AS teacherName, dept.dept_id AS deptId, dept.dept_name AS deptName FROM sys_user user INNER JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.dept_id = #{deptId} WHERE user.user_id = #{teacherId} AND user.dept_id = #{deptId} AND user.status = '0' AND user.del_flag = '0'

SELECT standard_id AS standardId, academic_year AS academicYear, semester, grade, required_lesson_count AS requiredLessonCount, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM biz_exemption_standard WHERE academic_year = #{academicYear} AND semester = #{semester} ORDER BY grade
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_exemption_standard (academic_year, semester, grade, required_lesson_count, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{academicYear}, #{semester}, #{grade}, #{requiredLessonCount}, #{operator}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE required_lesson_count = VALUES(required_lesson_count), update_by = VALUES(create_by), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: WITH class_candidate AS ( SELECT dept_id, entry_year, class_code FROM biz_teacher_class WHERE user_id = #{teacherId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND entry_year = #{entryYear} UNION SELECT assignment.dept_id, assignment.entry_year, assignment.class_code FROM biz_lesson_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.assigner_id = #{teacherId} AND assignment.dept_id = #{deptId} AND assignment.entry_year = #{entryYear} UNION SELECT history.dept_id, history.entry_year COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS entry_year, history.class_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS class_code FROM biz_lesson_assignment_history history WHERE (history.assigner_id = #{teacherId} OR history.advanced_by = #{teacherId}) AND history.dept_id = #{deptId} AND history.entry_year = #{entryYear} UNION SELECT scope.dept_id, scope.entry_year, scope.class_code FROM biz_lesson_class_scope scope INNER JOIN biz_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id AND lesson.dept_id = scope.dept_id WHERE lesson.creator_id = #{teacherId} AND scope.dept_id = #{deptId} AND scope.entry_year = #{entryYear} ) SELECT candidate.dept_id AS deptId, candidate.entry_year AS entryYear, candidate.class_code AS classCode, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user.user_id IS NOT NULL AND user.status = '0' AND user.del_flag = '0' THEN student.student_id END) AS validStudentCount FROM class_candidate candidate LEFT JOIN biz_student student ON student.entry_year = candidate.entry_year AND student.class_code = candidate.class_code LEFT JOIN sys_user user ON user.user_id = student.user_id AND user.dept_id = candidate.dept_id GROUP BY candidate.dept_id, candidate.entry_year, candidate.class_code ORDER BY CAST(candidate.class_code AS UNSIGNED), candidate.class_code

WITH teacher_course_scope AS ( SELECT scope.lesson_id, scope.dept_id, scope.entry_year, scope.class_code FROM biz_lesson_class_scope scope INNER JOIN biz_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id AND lesson.dept_id = scope.dept_id WHERE lesson.creator_id = #{teacherId} AND scope.dept_id = #{deptId} AND scope.entry_year = #{entryYear} UNION SELECT assignment.lesson_id, assignment.dept_id, assignment.entry_year, assignment.class_code FROM biz_lesson_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.assigner_id = #{teacherId} AND assignment.dept_id = #{deptId} AND assignment.entry_year = #{entryYear} UNION SELECT history.lesson_id, history.dept_id, history.entry_year COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS entry_year, history.class_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS class_code FROM biz_lesson_assignment_history history WHERE (history.assigner_id = #{teacherId} OR history.advanced_by = #{teacherId}) AND history.dept_id = #{deptId} AND history.entry_year = #{entryYear} UNION SELECT history.next_lesson_id, history.dept_id, history.entry_year COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS entry_year, history.class_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS class_code FROM biz_lesson_assignment_history history WHERE history.next_lesson_id IS NOT NULL AND (history.assigner_id = #{teacherId} OR history.advanced_by = #{teacherId}) AND history.dept_id = #{deptId} AND history.entry_year = #{entryYear} ), valid_student AS ( SELECT student.student_id, user.dept_id, student.entry_year, student.class_code FROM biz_student student INNER JOIN sys_user user ON user.user_id = student.user_id AND user.status = '0' AND user.del_flag = '0' WHERE user.dept_id = #{deptId} AND student.entry_year = #{entryYear} ), activity AS ( SELECT answer.lesson_id, answer.student_id, answer.submit_time AS activity_time FROM biz_student_answer answer INNER JOIN teacher_course_scope scope ON scope.lesson_id = answer.lesson_id INNER JOIN valid_student student ON student.student_id = answer.student_id AND student.dept_id = scope.dept_id AND student.entry_year = scope.entry_year AND student.class_code = scope.class_code WHERE answer.submit_time >= #{startTime} AND answer.submit_time < #{endTime} UNION ALL SELECT checkin.lesson_id, checkin.student_id, checkin.checkin_time FROM biz_lesson_checkin checkin INNER JOIN teacher_course_scope scope ON scope.lesson_id = checkin.lesson_id AND scope.dept_id = checkin.dept_id INNER JOIN valid_student student ON student.student_id = checkin.student_id AND student.dept_id = scope.dept_id AND student.entry_year = scope.entry_year AND student.class_code = scope.class_code WHERE checkin.checkin_time >= #{startTime} AND checkin.checkin_time < #{endTime} UNION ALL SELECT performance.lesson_id, performance.student_id, performance.create_time FROM biz_classroom_performance performance INNER JOIN teacher_course_scope scope ON scope.lesson_id = performance.lesson_id AND scope.dept_id = performance.dept_id INNER JOIN valid_student student ON student.student_id = performance.student_id AND student.dept_id = scope.dept_id AND student.entry_year = scope.entry_year AND student.class_code = scope.class_code WHERE performance.create_time >= #{startTime} AND performance.create_time < #{endTime} ), activity_metric AS ( SELECT scope.lesson_id, scope.dept_id, scope.entry_year, scope.class_code, MIN(activity.activity_time) AS usage_date, COUNT(DISTINCT activity.student_id) AS participant_count FROM teacher_course_scope scope INNER JOIN valid_student student ON student.dept_id = scope.dept_id AND student.entry_year = scope.entry_year AND student.class_code = scope.class_code INNER JOIN activity ON activity.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id AND activity.student_id = student.student_id GROUP BY scope.lesson_id, scope.dept_id, scope.entry_year, scope.class_code ), practical_metric AS ( SELECT scope.lesson_id, scope.dept_id, scope.entry_year, scope.class_code, COUNT(DISTINCT answer.answer_id) AS practical_due_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN answer.score IS NOT NULL THEN answer.answer_id END) AS practical_graded_count FROM teacher_course_scope scope INNER JOIN valid_student student ON student.dept_id = scope.dept_id AND student.entry_year = scope.entry_year AND student.class_code = scope.class_code INNER JOIN biz_student_answer answer ON answer.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id AND answer.student_id = student.student_id INNER JOIN biz_question question ON question.question_id = answer.question_id AND question.question_type = 'practical' WHERE answer.submit_time >= #{startTime} AND answer.submit_time < #{endTime} AND answer.student_answer IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(answer.student_answer) <> '' GROUP BY scope.lesson_id, scope.dept_id, scope.entry_year, scope.class_code ) SELECT scope.lesson_id AS lessonId, lesson.lesson_title AS lessonTitle, scope.dept_id AS deptId, scope.entry_year AS entryYear, scope.class_code AS classCode, activity.usage_date AS usageDate, COUNT(DISTINCT student.student_id) AS validStudentCount, activity.participant_count AS participantCount, IFNULL(practical.practical_due_count, 0) AS practicalDueCount, IFNULL(practical.practical_graded_count, 0) AS practicalGradedCount FROM teacher_course_scope scope INNER JOIN biz_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id INNER JOIN activity_metric activity ON activity.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id AND activity.dept_id = scope.dept_id AND activity.entry_year = scope.entry_year AND activity.class_code = scope.class_code LEFT JOIN valid_student student ON student.dept_id = scope.dept_id AND student.entry_year = scope.entry_year AND student.class_code = scope.class_code LEFT JOIN practical_metric practical ON practical.lesson_id = scope.lesson_id AND practical.dept_id = scope.dept_id AND practical.entry_year = scope.entry_year AND practical.class_code = scope.class_code GROUP BY scope.lesson_id, lesson.lesson_title, scope.dept_id, scope.entry_year, scope.class_code, activity.usage_date, activity.participant_count, practical.practical_due_count, practical.practical_graded_count ORDER BY scope.class_code, activity.usage_date, scope.lesson_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_exemption_application (dept_id, dept_name_snapshot, teacher_id, teacher_name_snapshot, academic_year, semester, grade, entry_year_snapshot, required_lesson_count, usage_threshold_pct, participation_threshold_pct, practical_threshold_pct, class_count, all_classes_qualified, practical_due_count, practical_graded_count, practical_rate, practical_qualified, teacher_remark, status, submit_time, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{deptId}, #{deptName}, #{teacherId}, #{teacherName}, #{academicYear}, #{semester}, #{grade}, #{entryYear}, #{requiredLessonCount}, 80.00, 50.00, 80.00, #{classCount}, #{allClassesQualified}, #{practicalDueCount}, #{practicalGradedCount}, #{practicalRate}, #{practicalQualified}, #{teacherRemark}, 'PENDING', NOW(), #{operator}, NOW())

INSERT INTO biz_exemption_class_snapshot (application_id, dept_id, entry_year, class_code, valid_student_count, required_lesson_count, used_lesson_count, usage_rate, usage_qualified, practical_due_count, practical_graded_count, practical_rate, create_time) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{deptId}, #{entryYear}, #{classCode}, #{validStudentCount}, #{requiredLessonCount}, #{usedLessonCount}, #{usageRate}, #{usageQualified}, #{practicalDueCount}, #{practicalGradedCount}, #{practicalRate}, NOW())

INSERT INTO biz_exemption_course_snapshot (application_id, class_snapshot_id, lesson_id, lesson_title_snapshot, entry_year, class_code, usage_date, valid_student_count, participant_count, participation_rate, counted_as_used, practical_due_count, practical_graded_count, practical_rate, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.applicationId}, #{item.classSnapshotId}, #{item.lessonId}, #{item.lessonTitle}, #{item.entryYear}, #{item.classCode}, #{item.usageDate}, #{item.validStudentCount}, #{item.participantCount}, #{item.participationRate}, #{item.countedAsUsed}, #{item.practicalDueCount}, #{item.practicalGradedCount}, #{item.practicalRate}, NOW())

INSERT INTO biz_exemption_attachment (application_id, original_file_name, resource_path, file_size, mime_type, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{originalFileName}, #{resourcePath}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{operator}, NOW())
mapper.sql: application.application_id AS applicationId, application.dept_id AS deptId, application.dept_name_snapshot AS deptName, application.teacher_id AS teacherId, application.teacher_name_snapshot AS teacherName, application.academic_year AS academicYear, application.semester, application.grade, application.entry_year_snapshot AS entryYear, application.required_lesson_count AS requiredLessonCount, application.usage_threshold_pct AS usageThresholdPct, application.participation_threshold_pct AS participationThresholdPct, application.practical_threshold_pct AS practicalThresholdPct, application.class_count AS classCount, application.all_classes_qualified AS allClassesQualified, application.practical_due_count AS practicalDueCount, application.practical_graded_count AS practicalGradedCount, application.practical_rate AS practicalRate, application.practical_qualified AS practicalQualified, application.teacher_remark AS teacherRemark, application.status, application.submit_time AS submitTime, application.reviewer_id AS reviewerId, application.reviewer_name_snapshot AS reviewerName, application.review_time AS reviewTime, application.review_remark AS reviewRemark, application.version
mapper.select: SELECT class_snapshot_id AS classSnapshotId, application_id AS applicationId, dept_id AS deptId, entry_year AS entryYear, class_code AS classCode, valid_student_count AS validStudentCount, required_lesson_count AS requiredLessonCount, used_lesson_count AS usedLessonCount, usage_rate AS usageRate, usage_qualified AS usageQualified, practical_due_count AS practicalDueCount, practical_graded_count AS practicalGradedCount, practical_rate AS practicalRate FROM biz_exemption_class_snapshot WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY CAST(class_code AS UNSIGNED), class_code

SELECT course_snapshot_id AS courseSnapshotId, application_id AS applicationId, class_snapshot_id AS classSnapshotId, lesson_id AS lessonId, lesson_title_snapshot AS lessonTitle, entry_year AS entryYear, class_code AS classCode, usage_date AS usageDate, valid_student_count AS validStudentCount, participant_count AS participantCount, participation_rate AS participationRate, counted_as_used AS countedAsUsed, practical_due_count AS practicalDueCount, practical_graded_count AS practicalGradedCount, practical_rate AS practicalRate FROM biz_exemption_course_snapshot WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY CAST(class_code AS UNSIGNED), class_code, usage_date, lesson_id

SELECT attachment_id AS attachmentId, application_id AS applicationId, original_file_name AS originalFileName, resource_path AS resourcePath, file_size AS fileSize, mime_type AS mimeType FROM biz_exemption_attachment WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY attachment_id
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_exemption_application SET status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewer_name_snapshot = #{reviewerName}, review_time = NOW(), review_remark = #{reviewRemark}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{version}
